title: Earthquake, flood, fire and other disasters
short: Earthquake, tsunami, flood, fire, staying indoors, leaving home
intro: Readings for the hazards people in Europe meet most: earthquakes, tsunamis on the coast, floods, fires at home and in the woods, and accidents that mean staying indoors or leaving home. Most pages come from Italian, German and Austrian civil protection.

read.label: During an earthquake
read.note: In Italian. Indoors: by a load-bearing wall or under a sturdy table, and do not rush out. Outdoors: away from buildings, trees, lamp posts and power lines.

read.label: After an earthquake
read.note: In Italian. First aid, shutting off gas, water and power, shoes on, no lift, the coast, phone and car, the town's waiting areas.

choices.label: Strong earthquake at the coast, or the sea pulls back
choices.hint: Tsunami signs and warnings, on the beach or in a harbour

read.label: The signs of a tsunami
read.note: In Italian. There may be no official warning: a strong earthquake, the sea suddenly pulling back, a roar from the sea.

read.label: Get high, fast, on foot
read.note: In Italian. After a warning or any one sign: the nearest high ground or upper floors, warn others, leave the car; boats.

read.label: After a tsunami
read.note: In Italian. More waves may follow; stay high until the authorities say otherwise; tap water and food.

choices.label: A flood warning has been given
choices.hint: Heavy rain, a river rising, an alert for my area

read.label: When a flood alert is issued
read.note: In Italian. Stay informed, do not sleep in basements, protect the ground floor, think twice before moving the car.

read.label: Protecting yourself in a flood
read.note: In Italian. Go upstairs, stay out of basements and underpasses, keep the phone for emergencies, a bag ready to leave.

read.label: Go higher, never into the basement
read.note: In German. In floods and heavy rain, higher floors protect; basements, underground car parks and underpasses can trap you.

choices.label: Water is rising around me
choices.hint: In a building, outside, or in a car

read.label: Indoors during a flood
read.note: In Italian. Go upstairs, not down to cellars or out for the car; no lift; gas and power off; help older and disabled neighbours.

read.label: Outdoors during a flood
read.note: In Italian. Leave the water, get to higher ground away from slopes, do not drive, avoid underpasses, river banks and bridges.

choices.label: The water has gone down
choices.hint: Going home, mud, cellars, gas and power

read.label: After a flood
read.note: In Italian. Wait for the authorities, keep off flooded roads, check gas and power, the drains, tap water and food.

choices.label: Fire or smoke at home
choices.hint: Smoke alarm, a fire in a room, smoke on the stairs

read.label: Fire at home: six steps
read.note: In German. Put it out only if it is safe, leave and close the door, warn others, never go through smoke, call 112.

read.label: Getting out, or waiting at the window
read.note: In German. With a smoke-free way out, leave; with smoke, close the doors, seal the gaps with wet cloths and wait at an open window.

read.label: Putting out a small fire
read.note: In German. Extinguishers and fire blankets, never water on burning fat or oil, and a person whose clothes are on fire.

choices.label: A forest fire is near
choices.hint: Smoke, flames in the woods, caught by the fire

read.label: If you see a forest fire, or are caught in one
read.note: In Italian. Call at once; how to get away, where to lie down, and when to cross to ground that has already burnt.

read.label: Report a fire, or even smoke
read.note: In Italian. Give the exact place and town. Italian numbers.

choices.label: Told to stay indoors: gas, smoke or radiation
choices.hint: A chemical or nuclear accident, explosions, a siren alarm

read.label: Where to shelter from gas, radiation or blasts
read.note: In German. Gas outdoors: go in, go up, seal windows and doors, ventilation off. Gas indoors: leave. Radiation or explosions: go as deep as you can.

read.label: Austria's sirens: warning and alarm
read.note: In German. On the alarm signal, go to a protected room or the cellar and switch on the radio.

read.label: Water and iodine after a nuclear accident
read.note: In German. Tap water may be unsafe for some days; iodine tablets only when the authorities say so.

choices.label: Thunderstorm in the mountains
choices.hint: Lightning, caught on a ridge or a summit

read.label: Thunderstorms in the mountains
read.note: In German. Warning signs, and which places give some protection and which give none.

choices.label: We may have to leave home
choices.hint: Emergency bag, documents, people who need help, pets

read.label: What to pack in an emergency bag
read.note: In German. The full list, from medicines and documents to a torch and a radio.

read.label: Important documents
read.note: In German. Which papers to keep together, in a fireproof or waterproof box, with copies.

read.label: If you need help to leave
read.note: In German. Aids, medicines, contacts, and working out who can help you get out.

limits.text: During an earthquake, do not rush outside: wait until the shaking stops.
After an earthquake, do not use the lift, and watch the stairs.
There may be no official tsunami warning: a strong earthquake or the sea suddenly pulling back is the signal to get to high ground.
Do not use the car to escape a tsunami: it can become a trap.
More dangerous waves may follow the first: do not go back until you are allowed.
In a flood, never go down to cellars, basements or garages to save things: you risk your life.
In a flooded basement you may be unable to open the door, and there is a risk of a fatal electric shock.
Even a few centimetres of fast water can knock you over or stall a car: keep away from underpasses, river banks and bridges.
Never escape through smoke: a few breaths of it can kill. If you are trapped, make yourself heard at a window.
Never put water on burning fat or oil.
In a fire, do not use the lift and do not jump from the window.
If you see a forest fire, call at once: do not assume someone else already has.
If gas or dangerous liquids escape inside a building, leave the building.
Take iodine tablets only when the authorities tell you to: they can have serious side effects.

prepare.label: Make the home safer before an earthquake
prepare.note: In Italian. Fix tall furniture, keep heavy things low, learn to shut off gas, water and power, know the safe spots.

prepare.label: How floods behave, and the most dangerous places
prepare.note: In Italian. Water can rise one or two metres in minutes.

prepare.label: Before a flood: plan, kit, valuables out of the cellar
prepare.note: In Italian. Also telling the town if someone at home needs help.

prepare.label: On the coast: a family plan for a tsunami
Documents in a waterproof folder, and flood sacks
Preventing forest fires
prepare.note: In Italian. Cigarettes, fires in the woods, cars on dry grass, rubbish, burning stubble, wind.
